specified_sector.scalars: Phi_d (q_Y=1/2, x=+1), Phi_u (q_Y=1/2, x=-1), colour singlets, six-dimensional, in the unit X flux

key_exact_statements: Lowest monopole harmonic of a |x|=1 scalar is the SU(2)_W doublet j=1/2 with internal mass 1/(2 r^2); next level 7/(2 r^2).
Zero-mode Yukawa overlap = 1/sqrt(4 pi), SU(2)_W covariant.
alpha_2^Phi = -8 tr M^2;  alpha_4^Phi = (2/3) R_6 tr M^2 + 4 tr M^4 + 4 tr|grad M|^2.
Quartic: lam_d|H_d|^4 + lam_u|H_u|^4 + lam_A(|H_d|^2|H_u|^2 + |H_d^T i s2 H_u|^2); common doublet mass parameter Lambda^2[2 m2/m1 - 5/(6 R^2)].
All local scalar coefficients through a_10 are identical for the published pair.
X anomalies per block (SU3^2X, SU2^2X, Y^2X, YX^2, X^3, grav^2X) = (1, 4, -4/3, 0, 57, 9); all Y and non-abelian anomalies vanish; 16 doublets.
ker M^2 = span{(1,1,0)} for all nonzero vevs and any Stueckelberg mass; e^-2 = K_WW + K_BB + 2 K_WB.
gamma depends on the Yukawas only through t = y_e^2/y_d^2: gamma = (3 m1 Nb/(16 pi^2)) (16 s^2 - 84 s + 144)/(4 s^2 - 24 s + 45), s = 3 + t; 4 <= g <= 5.
Zero modes integrated from the monopole Dirac equation reproduce the O(n-1)-section densities and the overlap 1/sqrt(4 pi).

key_numbers.scalar_hessian_exact: rank 4, nullity 5, gauge-orbit rank 4: one physical massless pseudoscalar

scope_limits: Scalar sector in the local heat expansion (a_2-a_4) while gauge coefficients and the radius potential are exact mode sums; exact scalar coefficients defined but not computed.
Untuned truncated minimum outside the local domain; no flat stationary radius; hierarchy requires an a_2-level input outside the stipulated trace.
Six-dimensional anomaly polynomial, two-form reduction, and M_St not computed.
Z_W/kappa inherited at eighteen printed digits, not recomputed.
No radion kinetic term, no full compactification stability, no quantum corrections, thresholds, or running; no prediction of the measured fine-structure constant or weak mixing angle.
The pair difference in e^-2 is exact at R_*; at the tuned coupled vacuum it has an O(eps) radius-splitting correction whose W part (dz_W/dR) is not available.
Retained zero-mode content has four chiral generations; phenomenological viability not addressed.
